title: Bench InfiniSplat v2 (multi-view feed-forward splat) on a 3D Scene path video, after 2.1
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1179 - New Models to Test. Menu: tasks/MPI-1179/plan.md. Candidate for the 3D Scene lift-back MPI-623 dropped: InfiniSplat v2 builds ONE Gaussian splat from 2-32 views with known cameras, and Render path already knows every frame's camera. Deferred past 2.1 (Fabio, 2026-10-18): the current 3D Scene works, and a newer model, or ATAS (being scoped on MiniMax-H3), may solve consistency and camera placement better.
